summary: Firefox adds support for the CSS `grid-lanes` display value, which enables a masonry-like way to arrange content, and improves scroll-driven animations so their timing ranges are respected during smooth, off-main-thread playback. It also fills out the CSS Typed OM, a browser API for working with CSS values and transforms, including numeric comparisons and matrix, perspective, and skew transforms. A wide set of CSS property handling and rendering fixes improves compatibility and correctness, including CSS zoom, text layout, and browser styles for form controls.
